pages.text: You can no longer see in very low light levels.$(br2)If an area is unlit and does not have a line of sight to the sky it will appear as pitch black darkness.$(br2)If you are on the surface and it's not a new moon (dark) you may be able to make out some things in the twilight.
Holding light emitting items will illuminate your surroundings.
Lanterns can be equipped to the belt slot and will act as if you were holding them.
